page_title: OVI 0-3 RMA | Oviedo v Real Madrid 24/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Ricardo De Burgos is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+3' 0 - 3 Goal! Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Brahim Diaz inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the bottom right corner. 0:3.
90+2' Federico Vinas (R. Oviedo) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Ricardo De Burgos has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
90+2' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Santi Cazorla (R. Oviedo) in, Leander Dendoncker out.
89' Haissem Hassan (R. Oviedo) hits an explosive shot from outside the penalty area and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
87' Xabi Alonso has decided to make a change. Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) replaces Kylian Mbappe.
87' Here comes a substitution. Daniel Carvajal is given a rest as he is replaced by Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid).
85' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Aaron Escandell has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
83' 0 - 2 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Vinicius Junior finds Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the bottom right corner. 0:2.
82' Kwasi Sibo (R. Oviedo) received a precise low pass and immediately unleashed a shot on goal. Unfortunately, he only found the left post.
80' Ricardo De Burgos rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid).
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Josip Brekalo (R. Oviedo) comes onto the pitch so that Ilyas Chaira can be given a rest.

78' A cross following the corner kick finds its way to Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) inside the box and he manages to steer it to the middle of the target. He is about to start celebrating a goal, but Aaron Escandell makes a save in the nick of time and maintains the current score.
78' Now Real Madrid have a corner.
77' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
74' Xabi Alonso has decided to substitute Arda Guler and he is replaced by Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid).
72' Veljko Paunovic decides to make a substitution. Salomon Rondon will be replaced by Federico Vinas (R. Oviedo).
72' That's the end of the game for Luka Ilic, who is replaced by Oviemuno Ejaria (R. Oviedo).
72' Dani Calvo (R. Oviedo) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
72' The attendance is 29758.
69' Kwasi Sibo (R. Oviedo) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by Thibaut Courtois.
67' A sweet pass inside the box gives Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
66' The resulting corner from Arda Guler (Real Madrid) is cleared by the defence.
66' Luka Ilic (R. Oviedo) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
65' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Ilyas Chaira (R. Oviedo).
65' R. Oviedo are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
63' Xabi Alonso has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) replacing Franco Mastantuono.
63' A substitution has been made. Rodrygo goes off and Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) comes on.
63' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
61' One of the players from R. Oviedo times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
60' Leander Dendoncker (R. Oviedo) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
59' Haissem Hassan (R. Oviedo) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
58' Nacho Vidal (R. Oviedo) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.

57' What a great effort! Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the left post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
56' Wonderful movement by Real Madrid. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
55' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from R. Oviedo for a penalty. Play continues.
53' Ricardo De Burgos interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Luka Ilic (R. Oviedo).
53' Alvaro Carreras (Real Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but Aaron Escandell comes off his line to gather the ball.
50' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) has a good chance to get on the scoresheet and fires the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
49' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
48' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Rodrygo (Real Madrid) took the corner.
48' The ball is cleared after Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Veljko Paunovic probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Oier Luengo (R. Oviedo). He is replaced by Haissem Hassan.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.

43' Real Madrid slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
40' Ricardo De Burgos sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
39' Wait! Referee Ricardo De Burgos has indicated he is going to review the Real Madrid goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
37' 0 - 1 Goal! Arda Guler plays a long ball to Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid), who cuts inside and unleashes a screamer into the bottom left corner. The keeper had no chance. Superb strike! 0:1.
36' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Real Madrid.

36' Aaron Escandell makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Arda Guler (Real Madrid) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the middle of the target.
36' Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) shows good awareness inside the box, but his attempt is stopped by the goalkeeper.
34' The referee blows his whistle, Real Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
33' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid).
33' Nacho Vidal (R. Oviedo) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle for a foul.
32' Aaron Escandell had to pull off an exquisite save to thwart a knuckleball from Arda Guler (Real Madrid), even though it only went towards the middle of the target.
30' Leander Dendoncker (R. Oviedo) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
29' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
27' Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
27' What a beautiful long-range strike by Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid). He is quite unlucky as his shot flies just over the bar.
26' Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

23' Leander Dendoncker (R. Oviedo) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!

22' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike to the bottom left corner. Aaron Escandell pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill.
20' A player from R. Oviedo commits a rough challenge. Ricardo De Burgos blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
18' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Rodrygo (Real Madrid). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
15' One of the Real Madrid players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
15' Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

14' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Real Madrid are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
12' The linesman makes the right call and Real Madrid will have a corner.
11' Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
11' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
9' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
8' A cross is whipped into the box by Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) and Kylian Mbappe controls it well. He lines up the ball, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention.
6' Real Madrid seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

5' What a great effort! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the right post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
3' Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

3' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
2' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Alvaro Carreras (Real Madrid) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
1' Salomon Rondon (R. Oviedo) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Thibaut Courtois.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! R. Oviedo will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Ricardo De Burgos.
